subject: general
question: The diameter of a bullock cart wheel is (14)/(11) m. This wheel makes ten complete revolutions per minute. What will be the speed of the cart in km/h?
solution: **Given:** The diameter of the bullock cart wheel is (14)/(11) m. **Formula used:** Circumference of circle = 2πr Speed = (Distance)/(Time) **Calculation:** Diameter of the wheel = (14)/(11) m
